answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 76 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in ferrous, queued in river, and sparrow publishes the wait time. A farm of 247 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1987 identities would post 3161 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
